messages:
Maya: Heads-up — v12 rollout triggered OOMs on staging-proxy (gpu-pool-3) for a subset of large-ctx requests. Heaptrace shows frequent kernel-switching + allocator spikes. Anyone on call?
Zach: I'm on it, looking at the profiler. I can already see repeated kernel churn when seq_len > 2048 and KV-cache allocations spike.
Zach: grabbing a live heap dump and NV profile now.
infra-bot: [alert] GPU OOM detected on instance gpu-pool-3-node-7 (pid 4211). Auto-backoff engaged.
Anita: If kernel switching is thrashing, we should try preferring the small-kernel codepath for the bigger models temporarily. Quick flag: --kernel-selection=prefer-small
Carl: Also consider shrinking workspace sizing for pool-3 to ~0.7x to force earlier eviction of ephemeral buffers and reduce spike pressure.
Maya: Can we apply a circuit-breaker at the proxy to reject requests with estimated tokens > 4096 (return 429 + Retry-After)? That buys time while we rollback.
Zach: Agree. Quick mitigations I'm going to run now:
Zach: ```sh
# enable kernel preference and shrink workspace on pool-3
redwoodctl set-pool gpu-pool-3 --env REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_FACTOR=0.7 --flag kernel_selection=prefer-small
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/pools/gpu-pool-3/actions/evict-kv-cache -d 'prefix=sess:'
```
Maya: I'll patch the proxy rule: if content-length > 1MB or estimated_tokens > 4096 -> route to slow-fallback endpoint (cpu-fallback) or return 429 for non-premium.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback of redwood-runtime:v12 -> redwood-runtime:v11 on pool gpu-pool-3.
Zach: Profiler dump uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/profiles/2001234567/nvprof-1 (nvprof + heap dump).
Anita: While rollback finishes: (1) add a soft circuit on public model routes to shed large-ctx traffic, (2) enable buffer-reuse debug metric, (3) schedule a targeted KV-cache eviction for suspect prefixes.
Carl: After rollback completes, run: 
Carl: ```sh
redwoodctl pool-action gpu-pool-3 evict-kv --prefix sess:large-ctx
redwoodctl update-pool gpu-pool-3 --env REDWOOD_BUFFER_REUSE=true
```
Maya: Follow-ups: add telemetry metric for kernel-switch churn (count switches per request), autotune kernel-selection thresholds based on observed seq-length distrib, and make workspace-factor per-model configurable surfaced in Console.
sre-oncall: Rollback finished; OOMs stopped. Monitoring for 10m.
Maya: Good work. Post-mortem items: capture minimal repro (replay trace), test preferred-kernel flag in canary, add a dedicated big-ctx pool (higher workspace factor) and a proxy rule to route premium big-ctx there.
Zach: I'll open an incident ticket with the profiler artifacts, the heap dump, and commands we ran. Adding suggested mitigation checklist to the incident. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
